inspiration.observed_pattern: A MariaDB report applies JSON_DETAILED to a JSON document to produce readable structured text.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one fixed nested JSON literal and one JSON_DETAILED projection so function recognition, formatting, and result metadata are isolated from table setup and report logic.

fixture_notes: One nested JSON literal isolates JSON_DETAILED output and metadata without rows, joins, or schema state.
determinism_notes: The JSON literal is fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
